container_config.go.name: Container settings
container_config.go.description: Holds a container's restart rule and health check settings.

container_wait.go.name: Wait for a container
container_wait.go.description: Lets a tool wait until a pretend container stops and reports how it ended.

diagnostic.go.name: Scenario error messages
diagnostic.go.description: Explains a mistake in a scenario file with its exact place and a short excerpt.

engine_core.go.name: Engine records
engine_core.go.description: Defines the pretend containers, networks and volumes and the engine that holds them.

engine_network.go.name: Networks and addresses
engine_network.go.description: Gives each pretend container its own address and service names on each network it joins.

engine_resources.go.name: Create and remove resources
engine_resources.go.description: Creates, finds and removes pretend networks, volumes and containers, refusing unsafe removals.

ledger.go.name: Call ledger
ledger.go.description: Writes every Docker call, service request and state change, in order, to a log file.

network_types.go.name: Port settings
network_types.go.description: Describes one published port, fixed or picked automatically.

runtime_error.go.name: Internal fault report
runtime_error.go.description: Tells apart a flaw in the stand-in itself from a failure a scenario asked for.

state.go.name: Container lifecycle
state.go.description: Moves each pretend container through starting, healthy, stopped and failed states, with its restart rules.
